prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 66-year-old teacher with a silver bob and a narrow face tries on a soft plain scarf given by two former pupils, now adults aged 28 and 31. In an empty classroom, one graduate adjusts a scarf end while the other smiles nearby. Her expression is touched and amused. Use warm afternoon window light, a blank board and clearly separate hands, scarf and clothing. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Wide horizontal 16:9 section composition. Keep all main faces, important hands and the complete action safely inside both central 4:3 and 1.65:1 crops, with natural environmental margins. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional anatomy and composition requirements: Show only these three adults: the silver-bobbed teacher aged 66 in a plain blouse, one former pupil aged 28 with short dark hair and round glasses, and one former pupil aged 31 with long auburn hair. Keep them compactly centred near a blank classroom board. The scarf is a single simple length of soft fabric, one end on each side of her neck; one graduate gently adjusts an end with two clearly distinct hands. Keep all faces and the scarf-adjusting action fully inside both central safe crops. Normal continuous furniture or clothing at the lower edge, no fake fade.

CORRECTION: Move the camera several steps farther back for a genuinely wide environmental classroom photograph. Show the teacher and both former pupils waist-up as one compact group in the middle 55 percent of image width, with a substantial visible classroom area on both sides. All three whole faces, all important hands and the entire scarf-adjusting action must be comfortably inside the central 4:3 crop and central 1.65 crop. No close-up, no person against an image edge. Maintain natural anatomy and one continuous photograph without fade or synthetic bands.
review: Reviewed replacement wide classroom photograph: silver-bob teacher tries on a plain scarf while two distinct adult graduates stand compactly beside her; one adjusts the scarf with separate plausible hands. All three whole faces and the scarf action are comfortably inside central 4:3 and 1.65 crops. Blank board, natural classroom light, no writing, fade or artificial strip.
